tasks.description: Set Up AssemblyScript Memory - Configure shared memory layout with TYPE_REGISTRY_OFFSET, SIGNATURE_TABLE_OFFSET, CONVERSION_TABLE_OFFSET, DISPATCH_CACHE_OFFSET
Implement Type ID Registry in WASM - Store type IDs and bit masks with registerType(), getTypeMask(), typeMatches() functions
Implement Signature Table - Store signature metadata with addSignature(), getParamCount(), getParamMask(), getFnIndex() for WASM dispatch
Implement WASM Dispatch Loop - Core hot-path dispatchFind() with bit-mask matching, optimized dispatchFind2() for 2-param signatures
Implement Dispatch Cache - LRU cache with FNV-1a hash, cacheLookup() and cacheStore() for repeated argument patterns
Create JS-WASM Bridge - TypeScript bindings for WASM functions with initWasm(), wasmDispatchFind(), wasmAddSignature()
Create WASM Loader - Handle sync/async loading with isWasmAvailable(), ensureWasm(), ensureWasmSync() and graceful fallback
Implement Pure-JS Fallback - Mirror WASM dispatch interface in pure JS with fallbackAddSignature(), fallbackDispatchFind()
Implement Type Mask Assignment - Map JS type checks to bit masks with getTypeBit(), getTypeMaskForValue(), getParamMask()
Integrate WASM with Dispatcher - Wire WASM dispatch into hybrid dispatcher with automatic fallback to JS for conversions
